title: Great climbing and even better guide
text: Had a great time rock climbing! The guide, Oriol was excellent. He was extremely thorough, kind, safe and very knowledgeable. He picked a climb that was suites to our level of capability and was just all around excellent making sure we had a great time. He really went above and beyond. Not to mention Montserrat is just beautiful.
author: corneliusv723

title: Great guided climb
text: The climbing guide, Oriol, was excellent with safety and detailed and comprehensive instructions.  The five pitches of climb and as the highlight of my climbing journey so far.  The view was spectacular, the weather was perfect, and the company of the guide was priceless.  I learned a lot about climbing, the geology of the region, animals and plants, the history, culture, food, languages, and tips for cities on my itinerary.  It is a great break from visiting sights!  Highly recommended!!
author: Brenda_H

title: Incredible experience!!
text:
Absolutely amazing experience! My husband and I have been indoor rock climbers for a few years now, but for our honeymoon, we were looking to test ourselves outside. This was the PERFECT experience for us. Pere was so informative, kind, and encouraging. He gave us tips and exercises to improve our climbing, and was very informative about climbing in the area. We did several routes (way more than we expected) and left feeling accomplished with ourselves. This is a great class for all skill levels, including beginners with little to no experience.

title: Great sport climbing
text: We had an excellent experience with Oriol.  After sport climbing in one area, he gave us the option to move to a new area as we have climbed quite a bit outside and he wanted to make sure we were adequately challenged.  We were, and it was great.  Highly recommend.
author: Joseph_M

title: Excellent Climbing
text: Very professional, they helped me since I started planning the project, taught me a lot and guided me. I will take them into account for future projects.
author: Diana S

title: Montserrat was awesome! So was pere
text: Such an epic experience! We had Pere was such a wonderful and friendly guide. 10/10 felt very safe — Pere is very experienced and the views were gorgeous. of course learned a lot about climbing and improving technique.
author: brancha2022

title: Great Guide, Great Climbing
text: My climbing guide, Pere Herms, was incredible. My friend and I climbed 7 different routes with him, and we enjoyed them all. Pere taught us how to become better climbers, from tying knots and belaying to improving footwork and balance. He ensured we climbed safely while motivating us to take on challenges. Pere genuinely wanted us to have the best climbs we could get, and we did.
author: michaelshriner

title: a great trip
text: We are absolute beginners and can only recommend the tour to everyone. our guide was Pere. on the first day we learned the basics from him. we have learned the knot and how to secure each other, have climbed some routes and have opened a route ourselves. we liked it so much that we climbed a mountain in montserrat with him the next day. it was a very nice day and we are looking forward to the next time.
author: oliverhro1312

title: A day at Montserrat
text: My daughter and I wanted to do some hiking and her dream to learn more outdoor climbing seemed to call us to this full day adventure. Our guide Xavi was truly a rock-star! He picked us up and drove us through congested traffic due to protests. He narrated our path and then we parked, loaded up and hiked up to where we would be climbing. All along the hike we saw olives, walnuts, wild asparagus, herbs and different plants. Then we climbed and learned and challenged ourselves.
